posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina and Vicky Kaushal's baby boy name revealed as Vihaan Kaushal. The new mom was also spotted among Bollywood's top yellow fashion icons this summer.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit creates history as the first Indian musician to sell out two consecutive nights at Madison Square Garden. His Imtiaz Ali film with Vedang Raina releases June 12.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia plays a deadly assassin 'raised and built to kill' in YRF's Alpha, releasing July 3. Bobby Deol praises her commitment to the intense action sequences.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka confirms six months of shooting still pending for SS Rajamouli's Varanasi. Also locked in to reprise her role as Priya in Hrithik Roshan's Krrish 4.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: King is shooting in Mumbai with a staggering ₹350 crore budget. Theatrical rights sold for ₹250 crore — one of Bollywood's biggest deals ever. Christmas 2026 release confirmed.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena wrapped filming Meghna Gulzar's Daayra with Prithviraj Sukumaran. Proud moment as son Taimur earns his yellow belt in Taekwondo.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha's long-awaited Naagin trilogy is officially back on track. Also rumored to play the female lead in Vicky Kaushal's mythological epic Mahavatar.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika filming King with SRK while expecting — using a body double for action scenes in Allu Arjun's Raka. Her climax sequences in King wrapping by mid-May.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: FWICE issues non-cooperation directive against Ranveer after his exit from Don 3, alleging ₹45 crore in losses. CINTAA backs him. His ₹300 crore zombie epic Pralay announced.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya remains one of Bollywood's most-followed stars. Fans eagerly await updates on her next big-screen project following her Cannes legacy.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika stars in Cocktail 2 with Shahid Kapoor (June 19 release) and takes on her first-ever villain role in Allu Arjun and Atlee's mega-budget AA22xA6.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Maa Inti Bangaaram trailer drops — Samantha in a fierce action avatar as a daughter-in-law hiding a dangerous past. Produced under her own banner, releasing June 19.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun is deep into shooting Atlee's AA22xA6 — a VFX-heavy parallel universe epic with multiple roles. The star-studded film targets a 2027 global release.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Peddi trailer smashes 175M views in 48 hours. Ram Charan reveals extreme body transformations left him injured. Grand AR Rahman musical event in Bhopal. June 4 release.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Dragon first glimpse shatters records with 64M+ YouTube views in 24 hours. Prashanth Neel calls it his 'darkest story ever.' NTR plays the menacing Luger.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi co-stars alongside Ram Charan in the highly anticipated Peddi (June 4) and joins the mega ensemble of Allu Arjun and Atlee's AA22xA6.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya caught up in Karan Johar's Instagram unfollow spree along with SRK, Alia and others — KJo calls it a 'digital detox.' She turned 27 with love from Suhana and Shanaya.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: New mom Kiara is embracing motherhood with baby Saraayah Malhotra. Up next: playing the fierce Nadia in Yash's Toxic and starring in War 2 with Hrithik.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik praises Jr NTR as his 'favourite co-star' ahead of their epic dance-off in War 2. Also confirmed to direct and star in Krrish 4 with Priyanka Chopra.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai locked for June 5 release — the first big Bollywood film post-IPL. Varun reunites with dad David Dhawan alongside Pooja Hegde and Mrunal Thakur.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya's 'The Unstoppable Tour' heads to Australia (June) and a massive US arena tour (September) — hitting Prudential Center, Oakland Arena, and more.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman's Peddi score goes viral — 'Chikiri Chikiri' crosses 200M views. Performing live at the grand Peddi Ki Aawaz event in Bhopal. Haazri 2026 tribute concert announced.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay set to become Tamil Nadu Chief Minister after historic election win. His swansong film Jana Nayagan eyes a June release. Son Jason Sanjay's directorial debut Sigma hits July 31.
